name: Miyoshi Kanae
source:
Kanae plays clarinet in the school's Brass Band Club. She is very meticulous and prepares carefully for everything. She is good friends with [url=/c98236]Kiko[/url], who she's in the same class as, and calls her "Pico-chan".

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
